## Professional Overview
Melwin Santhosh is an Integrated MCA scholar at St. Joseph's College of Engineering and Technology (SJCET), Palai, and a Platform Contributor at PRAX (an invite-only professional learning and continuous execution initiative by Vantcrest Labs Pvt. Ltd.). He specializes in AI-assisted developer toolchains, reproducible systems, interactive web platforms, and deterministic automation.
